name: COVID-19 Challenge
content: Problems and Purpose The "COVID-19 Challenge" is an initiative implemented by the non-profit organization "Red Ciudadana" with the aim of seeking solutions to community and municipal problems related to COVID-19. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation Interested parties can register their proposals online, which are then evaluated. Participants also receive online training in order to concretize the ideas presented and expose them to the jury . The winners receive $800 USD for the implementation of their idea. Registered proposals must focus on prototypes and functional physical solutions that can be developed from local, easily accessible, low-cost materials.
